description: Runs a preliminary check of a proposed company name in one US state: whether it carries the entity designator the entity needs, words that commonly need another agency's approval, and, in states whose business register is published as open data (CO, CT, NY, OR, PA), existing entities with the same or a similar name. Other states return the official name search to run by hand, and federal trademarks are not searched automatically (the USPTO search link is returned). Not a guarantee: the Secretary of State decides at filing. Reserves and files nothing. Free; does not consume credits.

entityType.description: Entity type the name is for. Default 'llc'.

name.description: The proposed company name, e.g. 'Sagebrush Studio LLC'.

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'CO', 'WY'.

name: formation.check_name

isError.description: True when the tool could not complete successfully.

text.description: Human-readable tool result (also mirrored in content[].text).

title: Check a business name
